# GFR Calculator

> Free online eGFR and creatinine clearance calculator. Computes CKD-EPI 2021, CKD-EPI 2009, MDRD, Cockcroft-Gault, cystatin C, and bedside Schwartz results in the browser, with step-by-step math and mg/dL / µmol/L unit conversion. Educational use only; not medical advice.

## Tool
- [GFR Calculator](https://gfrcalc.com/): the calculator, plus a CKD stage chart and an FAQ on formulas.

- [Creatinine clearance calculator](https://gfrcalc.com/creatinine-clearance-calculator): Cockcroft-Gault with actual, ideal, and adjusted body weight.
- [CKD-EPI calculator](https://gfrcalc.com/ckd-epi-calculator): the 2021 race-free equation with a worked example.
- [Cystatin C GFR calculator](https://gfrcalc.com/cystatin-c-gfr-calculator): eGFRcys and combined eGFRcr-cys.
- [Pediatric GFR calculator](https://gfrcalc.com/pediatric-gfr-calculator): bedside Schwartz equation.

## Guides
- [eGFR results explained](https://gfrcalc.com/egfr-results): what specific eGFR numbers mean.
- [How to improve GFR](https://gfrcalc.com/how-to-improve-gfr): when eGFR can recover and how to slow CKD.
- [eGFR blood test](https://gfrcalc.com/egfr-blood-test): what the test measures and what affects it.
- [CKD stages](https://gfrcalc.com/ckd-stages): KDIGO GFR categories G1-G5 and albuminuria categories A1-A3.
- [Normal GFR by age](https://gfrcalc.com/normal-gfr-by-age): average GFR by decade of life.
- [eGFR vs creatinine clearance](https://gfrcalc.com/egfr-vs-creatinine-clearance): units, BSA indexing, and use cases.
- [Creatinine converter](https://gfrcalc.com/creatinine-converter): mg/dL to µmol/L (factor 88.4).
- [Methodology](https://gfrcalc.com/methodology): formulas, constants, and literature sources.
